oneLiner: It collects your supplier invoices from their portals, so you never log in to download a PDF again.
forWhom: freelancers who lose an hour a month on invoices

problem.person: Léa, a freelance designer with eleven suppliers
problem.text: Every month she logs in to eleven portals to download eleven PDFs. She forgets two.

lines: You add a supplier's portal once, with the demo login.
A browser agent signs in and fetches every new invoice.
The PDFs land in one list, named and dated.

moment.text: Say "fetch my invoices" and watch the agent click through the portal.

lines: A browser agent that reads each portal like a person would.
Voice in, a dashboard out, on the starter's own stack.

why.line: Because the hour it gives back is real, and you can try it tonight.
